description: Cases where the same term is defined differently by different departments. Detected via the same pipeline as contradictions.json, but flagged as conflict_type='definition' rather than 'contradiction' since these are not necessarily errors -- both definitions can be legitimately in use for different purposes.

cases.definition_a: a paying account — an organization or individual that has an active, billed subscription or contract with Aurelia Technologies
cases.definition_b: any qualified lead that has entered the sales funnel and been marked "sales-qualified" by the SDR team, regardless of whether they have yet converted to a paid account
cases.resolution_reason: Not a factual error -- both definitions are legitimate within their own reporting context (revenue recognition vs. funnel/pipeline tracking). EKOS should surface this as a definitional divergence rather than resolve it via authority ranking.
